description_en: Logs on to an ECS instance
description_zh: 登录ECS实例，使用此API可以登录ECS实例
kebab_example: aliyun ecs-workbench login-instance --instance-login-info '{"Options":{"AudioMuteSeconds":1200,"NotificationEventTypes":"abc","FixedHeight":100,"OperationDisableSeconds":1200,"NotificationRetryLimit":3,"SessionControl":"abc","ContainerInfo":{"PodName":"abc","Endpoint":"abc","ClusterId":"abcdef","ContainerName":"abc","Headers":{"abc":"def"},"ClusterName":"abc","Deployment":"abc","Namespace":"abc"},"FixedWidth":100,"VideoFreezeSeconds":1200,"NotificationRecipientUrl":"abc","NotificationRetryIntervalSeconds":10},"ResourceGroupId":"rg-abcd","InstanceId":"i-123","NetworkAccessMode":"vpc/classic","Port":223389,"Host":"127.0.0.1","DurationSeconds":123,"ShortcutToken":"abcd","CredentialToken":"abcd","PassPhrase":"xxxx","DockerExec":"/bin/sh","LoginByInstanceShortcut":false,"VpcId":"vpc-abc","Username":"root/Administrator","DockerContainerName":"nginx","RegionId":"cn-hangzhou","InstanceType":"ecs/eci/ack","Protocol":"ssh/rdp/ack","ExpireTime":"2022-11-30_00:00:00","LoginByInstanceCredential":false,"EncryptionOptions":{"KMSKeyId":"example-string","Mode":"example-string","Enabled":true},"AuthenticationType":"password/certificate","Password":"xxxxx","Certificate":"example-string"}' --user-account '{"ParentId":1234,"Options":{"LoginLimit":3},"LoginName":"abc","AccountStructure":"2/3/4","AccountId":1234,"DurationSeconds":100,"AccountPlatform":"aas","EmpId":"123abc","ExpireTime":"2022-11-30_00:00:00"}' --partner-info PartnerId=abc PartnerName=abc --api-version 2022-02-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: LoginInstance
